description: This Java class 'CatalogServiceHelper' provides utility methods for manipulating product catalog data, including filtering descriptions by language and setting product availability based on regions and locale.

classes.name: CatalogServiceHelper
classes.description: A utility class for manipulating product catalog data, such as filtering descriptions by language and adjusting product availability based on region and locale.

methods.name: setToLanguage
methods.description: Filters product attribute descriptions to only include descriptions matching the specified language.

methods.name: setToAvailability
methods.description: Adjusts the product’s availability set to include only regional availabilities relevant to the provided locale.
